en: Color postcard-style panoramic view of a small town in a hilly, green landscape near a lake or wide river. The foreground shows orchards or cultivated fields with neat rows of trees. In the midground is a compact town with red-tiled roofs and a prominent church with a tall bell tower. Beyond the town lies blue water curving along the base of extensive green hills, with scattered farmhouses and small settlements on the slopes. A mountain ridge runs across the background under a bright blue sky with large cumulus clouds. There is no visible printed text on the image side.
